name: accessibility-compliance-helper
description: Open-source WCAG 2.2 accessibility auditor for HTML, JSX/TSX, Vue, Svelte, Razor and CSS: live diagnostics, quick fixes and a workspace health-score report (Markdown, JSON, HTML, SARIF).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension only reads files and never executes workspace code, so it runs fully in Restricted Mode.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Live diagnostics work on any open document; the workspace audit reads files through the VS Code file system API.

a11yHelper.enable.description: Show accessibility diagnostics in the Problems panel for open files.

enumDescriptions: Re-analyse when a file is opened or saved.

a11yHelper.showAdvisory.description: Show advisory (INFO) findings such as generic link text or missing new-window warnings. They never lower the health score.

a11yHelper.rules.contrast.description: Color Contrast — CSS / SCSS / LESS rules and inline styles (WCAG 1.4.3 / 1.4.11).

a11yHelper.rules.labels.description: Screen Reader Labels — accessible-name computation for interactive elements (WCAG 4.1.2).

a11yHelper.rules.landmarks.description: ARIA Landmarks — main / banner / contentinfo / navigation coverage in full HTML documents (WCAG 1.3.1 / 2.4.1).

a11yHelper.rules.headings.description: Heading Structure — missing / multiple h1, skipped levels, empty headings (WCAG 1.3.1 / 2.4.6).

a11yHelper.rules.altText.description: Alt Text Quality — missing alt, file names, placeholders, redundant phrases (WCAG 1.1.1).

a11yHelper.rules.links.description: Link Purpose — empty links, pseudo-buttons, generic text, unannounced new windows (WCAG 2.4.4 / 3.2.5).

a11yHelper.rules.media.description: Media & Embeds — captions, autoplay with sound, frame titles, object / embed alternatives (WCAG 1.2.2 / 1.4.2 / 4.1.2).

a11yHelper.rules.document.description: Page Metadata — lang, title, viewport zoom, meta refresh, duplicate ids and accesskeys (WCAG 3.1.1 / 2.4.2 / 1.4.4 / 2.2.1).

a11yHelper.rules.focus.description: Keyboard & Focus — positive tabindex, click-only elements, autofocus, removed focus outlines (WCAG 2.1.1 / 2.4.3 / 2.4.7).

a11yHelper.audit.exclude.description: Additional glob patterns excluded from the workspace audit (node_modules, dist, build, .git and similar folders are always skipped).

a11yHelper.audit.maxFileSizeKB.description: Files larger than this are skipped by live diagnostics and the workspace audit.
